annotations.title: Which reason to buy do people search for, and which is growing?

description: Use when the user is choosing a positioning, a message or a campaign angle and asks which benefit or reason to buy matters most to buyers, or which is gaining. Returns, for each angle searched with the category, its share of searches among the angles named, its year-on-year change and its growth beyond an everyday control basket, with a volume band. Shares and bands only. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.07 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/angle-demand.json
